rows.label: tlk44400084_01_msg0001
rows.name:
I haven't seen clothes like yours.
Are you from another country?

rows.label: tlk44400084_01_msg0002
rows.name:
You must find Luxuria rather
nippy, no? Feel free to warm
yourselves up here.

rows.label: tlk44400084_01_msg0003
rows.name:
Hot water is piped here. Water heated
inside the Divine Beast circulates
throughout the capital.

rows.label: tlk44400084_01_msg0004
rows.name:
It's hard to get a warming meal
around these parts, so I come here
every day just to warm myself up.
